title: Team member closeout: Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (14a56a) — sixth directorship delivered (four merges, Track-G complete, re-proof routed, micro-queue drained); authority with Iridescent Threading Constellation; zero claims retained
body:

- Outcome: FOUR merges Director-serialised with both evidence loops + scope verified first-hand every time — #172 (52472d2ab, lifecycle-lease gate-helper), #173 (c868bb52e, get-keyword-graph — TRACK-G COMPLETE IN FULL), #174 (6340c595b, ARC n=3 evidence conserved), #175 (5310d1e4e, AGGREGATED_TOOL_ORDER — reliability micro-queue DRAINED). The eef-revalidation re-proof plan PROMOTED future/->current/ (owner-decided) and ROUTED to Blustery (proof rounds already green at my stand-down; multiplicity + G4b determinations recorded). Q-008 retired answered-in-place. Choreographed live: two G4b PDR-063 rotations (Cindery->Blustery pickup chain), the ARC n=1 contraction (Oceanic->Hushed), Prismatic + Smouldering + Scorched standby routing, and the Smouldering GO (worktree contention verified first-hand — fresh worktree designated).
- Evidence: merge SHAs above; waypoints ceae1feb2 + 2770e1821 + 22a418a76 (all pushed, transfer-line + ls-remote proven); Moment-1 9c8326a1; Iridescent's Moment-2; comms events throughout.
- Claims / queue / git state: ZERO retained — 1d37fdfe closed citing Iridescent's Moment-2; predecessor-claim dispositions all discharged (8ba9e931, be2de6b4 closed at my hand on successor pickups; handoff_record_path pointers set per the no-CLI-verb convention). Queue empty of my intents. Coordination home pushed level at 22a418a76; only live registry/comms churn after it (incl. this closeout wave) — rides the seventh holder's first docs(continuity) commit, the standing pattern.
- Session complete announcement: YES — Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (14a56a) stands down at the completed sixth-to-seventh succession.
- Retained claims: NONE.
- Pickup notification required: none — Iridescent Threading Constellation (f9454b) is active with claim 537f2f1c and the full Moment-1 package; their Moment-2 already ratifies my Smouldering GO and the Prismatic standby contract.
- IN-FLIGHT TRANSFER (monitoring): my PR #176 Director monitor stops with this closeout — Iridescent, #176 (final ARC conservation, Hushed shepherding) was at 4-pass/2-pending at my last read; arm your own monitor; the merge ask will come to you. No other open PRs.
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: follows this event (loop stopped FIRST, per the ordering cure).
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) a closeout's worktree-state claim goes stale within minutes — routing facts re-derive from the live registry + git -C at COMPOSE TIME (my stale-ADOPTABLE error, peer-caught by Hushed; napkinned; the same check then caught evergreen-rel in live use before the Smouldering GO — the lesson paid for itself twice over within the hour); (2) the canonical watcher's fail-loud drain-timeout fired once mid-session and the restart-with-same-seen-file path worked exactly as designed — but the gap window held real events; sweep the directed backlog after any watcher restart; (3) commitlint footer-leading-blank phantom = a "PR #<n>" body line (Pier's root cause, confirmed empirically on my own waypoint commits — write "PR 173" in commit bodies).
- Blockers or risks: none. All lanes settled or correctly held: Blustery re-proof landing (Scorched standing by at their boundary), Hushed closeout arc (#176 + handoff record for Prismatic), Smouldering w1-c1 under GO, owner items held as-is.
- Handoff needed: COMPLETE — Moment-1 9c8326a1 + Iridescent's Moment-2 + this closeout.
